mapper.insert: insert into batch.batch_window ( tenant_id, window_code, window_name, timezone, start_time, end_time, end_strategy, out_of_window_action, allow_cross_day, enabled, description ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{windowCode}, #{windowName}, #{timezone}, #{startTime}::time, #{endTime}::time, #{endStrategy}'FINISH_RUNNING', #{outOfWindowAction}'WAIT', #{allowCrossDay}false, #{enabled}true, #{description} ) on conflict (tenant_id, window_code) do update set window_name = excluded.window_name, timezone = excluded.timezone, start_time = excluded.start_time, end_time = excluded.end_time, end_strategy = excluded.end_strategy, out_of_window_action = excluded.out_of_window_action, allow_cross_day = excluded.allow_cross_day, enabled = excluded.enabled, description = excluded.description, updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.update: update batch.batch_window set window_name = #{windowName}, timezone = #{timezone}, start_time = #{startTime}::time, end_time = #{endTime}::time, end_strategy = #{endStrategy}, out_of_window_action = #{outOfWindowAction}, allow_cross_day = #{allowCrossDay}, enabled = #{enabled}, description = #{description}, updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id}
